svg.title: Customer Churn AI Agent Workflow Diagram
svg.desc: End-to-end LangGraph agent workflow: user input flows through XGBoost prediction, SHAP explanation, segment stats, RAG retrieval, and LLM synthesis to produce a retention report.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the customer data input in this project')
sendPrompt('What is LangGraph and how does it orchestrate the agent?')
g.text: State machine — decides which tools to call

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the XGBoost churn prediction tool work?')
sendPrompt('How does SHAP explain the churn prediction?')
sendPrompt('What does the customer segment stats tool do?')
sendPrompt('How does the RAG retrieval system work in this project?')
sendPrompt('What embedding model is used in the FAISS vector store?')
sendPrompt('What is the knowledge base used for retention strategies?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM synthesise all tool outputs into a report?')
g.text: Inputs: churn label · SHAP top drivers · segment context

svg.text: Report tone adapts to prediction outcome

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the high-risk churn report contain?')
sendPrompt('What does the retention-safe report contain?')
sendPrompt('How is the final report displayed to the user in Streamlit?')
g.text: Markdown report rendered in premium UI
